source_integrity_findings: The main Methods and Supplement Table S3 footnote define laboratory summaries from the prior year, while the Figure S2 note says the prior month for hemoglobin A1c and eGFR. The discrepancy was preserved rather than reconciled.
Supplement Table S3 labels an index-year subgroup as 2019-2022, while enrollment ended October 31, 2020 and the main subgroup specification uses 2019-2021. The discrepancy was preserved.

The article states that no new data were created or analyzed, despite reporting analyses of Danish registry data. That exact data-sharing wording was preserved as a directly reported atom and was not silently corrected.
extraction_limitations: The extraction prioritizes independently reviewable study design, population, primary and secondary cardiovascular results, prespecified subgroup estimates, sensitivity analyses, limitations, conclusions, and disclosures rather than atomizing every baseline table cell or code in Supplement Table S2.
Exploratory age, civil-status, and employment subgroup estimates are tagged as exploratory and are not promoted to confirmatory treatment-effect claims.
All atoms remain needs_review because no independent human reviewer verified the model-assisted extraction.
No external current-practice verification was performed because @VERIFY was not activated.
